body:
pdca.toml's REMOTE CONTROL note and docs/INTEGRATION.md both instruct: 'To enable, APPEND the flag to the argv line'. But the driver seeds every interactive leaf as `subprocess.run(argv + [seed])` (leaves.py `_seed_positional`, #313) — the prompt is the FINAL positional — and `--remote-control` takes an optional `[name]`. Following the doc verbatim therefore makes the flag consume the entire seed prompt as the RC session name: Remote Control fails to start ('check the debug log') and the REPL opens with no seed. Hit in practice on the pdca-pdca instance the first time the flow reached a planner after enabling RC (eduralph/pdca-pdca#19; fixed there by moving the flag before `--agent`).

Two-part fix:

1. **Docs** (cheap, closes the trap): the example should place the flag NON-last (e.g. right after `"claude"`) and say why — any flag with an optional value must never sit last in an interactive leaf's argv, because the seed is appended as a positional after it.
2. **Driver hardening** (kills the class): when seeding an interactive claude-family leaf, append the seed after an end-of-options separator (`argv + ['--', seed]`) if the CLI supports it — then NO trailing optional-value flag can ever swallow the seed, whatever an instance puts in its argv. Worth a families-profile bit if support differs per vendor CLI.

Symptom signature for the changelog: interactive leaf opens empty + 'error trying to start remote control / check the debug log', while in-session `/remote-control` works fine on the same machine.
title: REMOTE CONTROL doc example ('append the flag') collides with the positional seed — an optional-value flag at argv end swallows the prompt
